name: Mahou Tenshi Misaki 2
source: You play as Misaki a young girl who dreams of being a magical girl. Suddenly a monster appears in front of you. Use the magical jewel to become Magical Angel Misaki and fight against evil!
translation: 玩家扮演Misaki，一名梦想成为魔法少女的年轻女孩。某天，一只怪物突然出现在你面前。使用魔法宝石变身为魔法天使Misaki，与邪恶战斗吧！
